tasks.title: Export a note as Markdown
tasks.plan:
# Export a note as Markdown: plan

Download the note as UTF-8 Markdown. Preserve headings and lists. Use a safe filename.
tasks.result:
# Export a note as Markdown

The prepared change adds Download Markdown. Review the diff and example tests, including Unicode and empty notes.

This is a fictional example task.
tasks.diff:
diff --git a/app/export-markdown.js b/app/export-markdown.js
--- a/app/export-markdown.js
+++ b/app/export-markdown.js
@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+download(new Blob([markdown], { type: "text/markdown;charset=utf-8" }), "note.md");

tasks.title: Show when a note is saved
tasks.plan:
# Show when a note is saved: plan

Show Saving while a save is pending, Saved after success, and a retry message on failure.
tasks.result:

# Dark mode plan

## Your decision

Follow the system setting by default, with a saved Light / Dark / System override.

1. Add keyboard-accessible theme controls.
2. Apply colors to editor and navigation.
3. Save the selection and restore it on refresh.

## Acceptance checks

Check the chosen default, keyboard selection, readable text, and persistence.
